Card Q&A.a: 1 play cost 11 or lower Digimon card with the [Cyborg] trait or 1 play cost 11 or lower Digimon card with the [Machine] trait.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played by this card's [All Turns] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 7 or less.

[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 play cost 11 or lower Digimon card with the [Machine] or [Cyborg] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
Special Play Condition: DigiXros -2: [Raijinmon]×[Fujinmon]×[Suijinmon] When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
